import struct, subprocess, os, itertools, sys
H3_INIT=35184372088831
H3_MODE_OFFSET=59; H3_RES_OFFSET=52; H3_BC_OFFSET=45
H3_MODE_MASK=((15)<<H3_MODE_OFFSET); H3_RES_MASK=(15<<H3_RES_OFFSET); H3_BC_MASK=(127<<H3_BC_OFFSET)
def h3(res, bc, digits=()):
    h=H3_INIT
    h=(h & ~H3_MODE_MASK) | (1<<H3_MODE_OFFSET)
    h=(h & ~H3_RES_MASK) | (res<<H3_RES_OFFSET)
    h=(h & ~H3_BC_MASK) | (bc<<H3_BC_OFFSET)
    for r,d in enumerate(digits, start=1):
        off=(15-r)*3
        h=(h & ~(7<<off)) | (d<<off)
    return h
origins=[h3(0,bc) for bc in [0,4,14,117]] + [h3(1,bc,[d]) for bc in [0,4,14,117] for d in range(0,8)]
vals=[-2147483648,-2147483647,-1073741824,-1000000000,-1000,-2,-1,0,1,2,1000,1000000000,1073741824,2147483646,2147483647]
count=0
for origin in origins:
  for i,j in itertools.product(vals, repeat=2):
    data=struct.pack('<QQiiI', origin, origin, i,j,0)+b'\0'*4
    open('/tmp/poc','wb').write(data)
    p=subprocess.run(['/tmp/fuzzerLocalIj','/tmp/poc'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    count+=1
    if p.returncode not in (0,):
      err=p.stderr.decode('latin1','replace')
      if 'AddressSanitizer' in err or 'runtime error' in err:
        print('FOUND',hex(origin),i,j,'rc',p.returncode,'count',count)
        print(err[:4000])
        sys.exit()
print('done',count)
